home.title: An empty starting point
home.text: Auth, two identity systems, archiving, audit logs, rate limiting, bilingual UI and dark mode are already in place. Replace this text and start adding your own.
home.next1: Add your tables in packages/db/src/schema.ts — if a table gets archived_at, wire it into the archive
home.next2: Define enums and validation in packages/shared/src/schemas.ts, shared by both sides
home.next3: Run pnpm check — seven seconds to find out what you forgot to wire up

me.title: Account
me.passwordHint: Changing your password signs out every other device immediately.
me.passwordDone: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

accounts.confirmArchive: Move “{{name}}” to the archive? They lose access immediately, but you can restore them any time.
accounts.archiveHint: Disabling and deleting are different: a disabled account stays on this list, a deleted one moves to the archive.

archive.intro: Deleting anywhere in the admin only moves it here — the data is still in the database. Permanent deletion happens on this page only, and cannot be undone.
archive.confirmPurge: Permanently delete “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.

settings.enHint: Leave an English field empty and the site falls back to the Chinese one — no need to fill in both every time.
settings.testEmailHint: Once the domain and API key are configured, send one to yourself first. Not receiving it usually means the domain's DNS hasn't verified — and in that case real users won't receive anything either.

image.unsupported: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported

error.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknownCode: That didn't go through ({{code}}, HTTP {{status}}). Send us a screenshot of this line and we can trace it.

field.datetime: Not a valid date and time
field.oneOf: Not one of the allowed values

code.invalid_input: Some of the details are wrong. Please check and try again.
code.forbidden: This account doesn't have permission to do that.
code.not_found: Not found — it may have been deleted already.
code.internal_error: Server error. Send us a screenshot of this page; it will be in the logs.
code.account_disabled: This account has been disabled. Please contact an administrator.
code.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait a while and try again.
code.too_many_requests: Too many requests. Please try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
code.username_taken_archived: That username belongs to a deleted account. Restore it from the archive, or pick another name.
code.cannot_disable_self: You can't disable or delete your own account — that would lock you out.
code.cannot_demote_self: You can't demote yourself — that would lock you out.
code.account_has_uploads: This account uploaded {{count}} image(s); deleting it would break the record of where they came from.
code.unsupported_image_type: Only JPEG, PNG and WebP are supported.
code.image_too_large: That image is too large. Please compress it first.
code.email_not_configured: Email isn't configured yet (RESEND_API_KEY and EMAIL_FROM), so nothing can be sent.
code.email_send_failed: The email didn't go out. The sending domain most likely hasn't been verified.
